chapter: The Lunceford years: Europe, rivals and bandsmen
title: Cities played and no segregation in Europe
summary: Crawford lists Scandinavia and London on the tour and says the band met no segregation and stayed in good white hotels.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: But how was the tour, far as -- how many countries did you play?
Oh, all of them, Sweden, main cities of Sweden, Norway, Denmark, London, didn't play Paris, but I was there.
How was the -- did you all -- did you experience any segregation in Europe when you went to Europe?
No, not any, as I recall, not any.

Stayed at white hotels, yes, not maybe the best, but they were good, because Lunsford, they wouldn't let us, as a matter of fact, no, we had to stay in a good hotel. Yeah, Lunsford was a wonderful gentleman.
